title: Resource usage
scope: This computer only: the Yuzora app, the tools it starts, and its herdr-core with the terminals and agents in it. Remote (SSH) Spaces are not measured.

detail.tools: git, ssh, database helpers, hc connect

no_sample: No sample yet. Unknown usage is not zero.
core_pid: herdr-core is the server with pid {pid} and everything under it and its holders.
core_missing: herdr-core was not measured and counts 0: {error}
measurement: Memory is RSS in decimal MB. CPU is relative to one core and can exceed 100%; totals are sums.
cadence: Sampled every 2 s while the window is in front.
sampling: Last {attempts} polls: {failures} failed · {empty} empty · {skipped} skipped without focus.
cost: One sample takes {median} ms (median) · {p95} ms (p95) over the last {samples}.
